children: McGraw Hill announced a proposed $500 million offering of senior secured notes due 2033 and a coordinated refinancing of its credit facilities.
Issuer to offer $500 million senior secured notes due 2033 in a private Rule 144A/Reg S placement.
Planned amendments extend revolver maturities to 2031 and increase revolver commitments to $150 million.
Existing term loan to be refinanced with an $830 million first‑lien term loan B due 2033 (A&E Term Loan Facility).
Net proceeds plus A&E borrowings intended to redeem 5.750% secured notes due 2028 and refinance the existing term loan.
Conditional redemption notice issued for the 2028 notes; expected redemption date is October 9, 2026, subject to closing.
